title: A high-order, meshless, Lagrangian--Eulerian RBF-FD method for advection--diffusion--reaction on moving manifolds
summary: We present a high-order radial basis function-generated finite difference (RBF-FD) method for partial differential equations on moving manifolds $\mathcal M(t)\subset\mathbb R^3$ of co-dimension one. Our method builds on the tangent-plane formulation of surface RBF-FD and combines Lagrangian and Eulerian treatments: the manifold and material derivative are evolved in a Lagrangian fashion, while the remaining surface differential operators are reconstructed on the instantaneous point cloud and stabilized, when necessary, by a quasi-analytical hyperviscosity formulation.
